snippet.title: War of the Western Deep - Steam Demo Reveal
snippet.description:
Demo now available on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976440/War_of_the_Western_Deep/

War of the Western Deep puts you in control of your very own classically animated adventure. You are a royal courier stranded in foreign territory on the brink of war. Immerse yourself in a lush, hand-made world as you explore an innovative mix of exploration and cinematic combat.
